question: For the primary collision factor violation category that was the most common cause of traffic accidents in 2021, how many percentage points did its share of annual road incidents in 2021 decrease compared to its share in 2011?
sql:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as yr,
        COUNT(*) as total,
        ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as share_pct
    FROM collisions 
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2011, 2021)
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2021 THEN share_pct END) as share_2021,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN share_pct END) as share_2011,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2021 THEN share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN share_pct END), 2) as change_from_2011_to_2021
FROM totals
